Growth Marketing Analyst

About the role
You will own funnel measurement for growth campaigns and advise acquisition teams.

What you will do
- Build dashboards and run experiments on landing pages
- Define north-funnel metrics with product managers

Requirements
Skills: SQL, Python, A/B testing, Looker, Google Analytics
Experience: 2+ years in marketing analytics or growth data
Nice to have: experimentation frameworks, retail or e-commerce domain
Tools: Amplitude, BigQuery, dbt
